bns:Component.name: Scheduled_Purge_Retention
bns:Component.bns:description: Scheduled maintenance process for the Endeavour Mining P2P integration framework (build plan step 8). MIGRATED 2026-09-25 from MySQL/Database (Legacy) to SQL Server/Database V2 - calls EDV_INTEGRATION.SP_PURGE_RETENTION via Send_SP_PurgeRetention_V2. No Data start, suitable for scheduling. SCHEDULING NOTE: this skill has no CLI/API tool for configuring a process's execution schedule (frequency/cron) - after deploying, set the schedule via the Boomi GUI (Atom Management -> Scheduling) or the platform's ProcessSchedules API directly. UNVERIFIED (least confident part of this migration): Database (Legacy) has a dedicated storedProcedure/spread mechanism for zero-argument stored procedures with no documented Database V2 equivalent - this rebuild guesses a Standard Update with "EXEC EDV_INTEGRATION.SP_PURGE_RETENTION" as raw query text, driven by an empty '{}' Message document (per databasev2_connector_operation_component.md's documented pattern for parameterless Standard Get/Update queries). MUST be tested via boomi-test-execute.sh once the SQL Server Database V2 driver (Custom Library) is confirmed attached to the atom - see Send_SP_PurgeRetention_V2's description for what to adjust if it fails. Since Database V2's successful Update returns a real response document (unlike Database Legacy's zero-document Send), the success Notify/Stop after it should now actually execute (harmless either way, kept for GUI readability). | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57
